resources.whatItTakes: You need a skill or knowledge gap you can close for a specific group of people — not expertise in everything, just enough to be ten steps ahead of your student. The real work is translating what you know into a logical sequence a beginner can follow, then filming it clearly enough that someone watching at midnight on a laptop actually learns. Video editing, a halfway-decent microphone, and a platform like Teachable or Gumroad handle the infrastructure.
resources.whereTheyFail: Most people spend three months perfecting a course nobody asked for. They record 40 lessons, obsess over slide design, then launch to silence because they skipped validation entirely. The third is abandoning the course after the launch week spike disappears and assuming the idea failed, when really the marketing just ran out.
resources.theDip: Weeks four through ten after launch. The initial burst of sales from your network dries up, organic traffic hasn't built yet, and you're staring at a sales dashboard that barely moves. This is where most creators either panic and discount heavily — which trains your audience to wait for sales — or simply stop promoting and let the course go dormant. The people who push through this period are the ones who treat marketing as a recurring weekly job, not a launch event.

aiPrompts.prompt:
Build a complete course outline for [topic] targeting [audience].

Course details:
- Topic: [specific outcome the student gets]
- Target student: [persona — current state]
- Outcome: [transformation — desired state]
- Length: [4-week / 8-week / self-paced 6-12 hours]
- Price tier: [$97 starter / $297-497 mid / $997-2997 premium]

Output:

POSITIONING:
- Hook (the promise — outcome-led, not feature-led)
- Pain it solves (3 specific pains)
- Who it's NOT for (sets expectations + filters)

MODULE STRUCTURE (4-8 modules, 60-90 min each):

Module 1: [foundation / mindset shift]
Module 2-N: [skills/systems progression]
Final Module: [implementation + community / ongoing system]

PER MODULE:
- Module objective (1 sentence)
- 3-6 lessons (each 8-15 min)
- 1 worksheet / template / asset per module
- 1 implementation checkpoint (what they have at end)

BONUSES (3-5):
- Templates / scripts / swipe files
- 1 community access tier
- 1 expert interview / case study

PRICE JUSTIFICATION:
- ROI math (if used: $X return for $Y invested)
- Comparison anchor (vs $5K coaching, $200/hr consultant)

REFUND POLICY:
- 30-day satisfaction guarantee with implementation requirement (proves they actually tried)

Write a long-form sales page for [course].

Course: [name + outcome]
Target student: [persona]
Price: [$X]
Founder credibility: [your story / wins / proof]
Existing testimonials: [paste 3-5]

Structure:

ABOVE-FOLD:
- Headline (outcome-led, specific)
- Sub-headline (who + how + when)
- Hero image / video placeholder
- 3-bullet "you'll learn" preview
- Anchor CTA button

PAINS SECTION:
- 5-7 specific pains your student has TODAY
- Sets up the gap

PROMISE SECTION:
- The transformation (their state in 30/60/90 days)
- Proof of method (your case study + 2-3 student stories)

COURSE BREAKDOWN:
- Each module with outcome bullet + 1 line of teaser
- Total deliverables count (lessons, worksheets, etc)

BONUSES:
- 3-5 with $X value attached to each

ABOUT THE FOUNDER:
- Story (why you teach this) — 200 words max
- Credentials / wins
- Why you're qualified

TESTIMONIALS:
- 5-8 with photo + name + result
- Mix beginner + advanced wins

GUARANTEE:
- 30-day refund with implementation requirement

PRICING SECTION:
- Anchor (alternative cost: $5K coach / $50K mistake)
- 1-pay vs 3-pay options
- Final CTA

FAQ:
- Top 8 objections answered

POST-PURCHASE:
- Welcome email subject line
- Day 1 lesson teaser

Tone: confident, specific, no hype.

Email 2 (Tue — pain agitation):

Email 3 (Wed — proof):

- CTA: see the system → sales page

Email 4 (Thu — urgency / objections):
- Subject: deadline mention
- Body: top 3 objections + answers
- CTA: enroll before [deadline]

Email 5 (Fri — final close):
- Subject: doors close at midnight
- Body: 1 final story + clear ask
- CTA: enroll now (last call)

For each:
- Subject line + 2 alts
- Preheader
- 250-350 word body
- Single clear CTA

Tone: friend-to-friend, not marketer.

commonMistakes.why: Most failed courses are built in isolation. Founder writes 8 modules of content nobody asked for. Launch flops. 6 months wasted.
commonMistakes.prevention: Validates demand + funds production. AI helps draft pre-sale emails.

commonMistakes.why: Students don't finish, don't implement, don't recommend.
commonMistakes.prevention: Higher prices filter for committed students who actually do the work.

commonMistakes.mistake: No audience / no email list before launch
commonMistakes.why: Cold sales pages convert at 0.5-2%. Warm email lists convert at 5-10%. No list = no sales.
commonMistakes.prevention: 6+ months of content + email list building BEFORE first launch. Free lead magnet → email sequence → soft pre-sale.

commonMistakes.why: A 47-video course with no clear path = student overwhelm = no completion = no testimonials = no future sales.
commonMistakes.prevention: Modular journey with clear outcomes per module + implementation checkpoints. 4-8 modules, not 12+.

commonMistakes.why: Adding live calls or community drives completion to 50%+ AND charges premium.
One-time courses are top-of-funnel. Real revenue is in continuity (membership, mastermind, certification).
commonMistakes.prevention: Plan upsell from day 1: course → community → mastermind.

toolComparisons.recommendation: Teachable for simplicity. Thinkific for community + advanced features. Kajabi for all-in-one (course + email + funnels). Mighty Networks for community-first.

options.name: Teachable
options.bestFor: Simple, fast launch, good for first course

toolComparisons.recommendation: Loom for quick lesson videos. Riverside for podcast-style. Camtasia for screen-record + edit in one.
ConvertKit for automation depth. Beehiiv for newsletter + courses combo. Active Campaign for advanced funnels.

options.nextStep: Run 4 cohorts/year. Live calls. Higher completion + premium positioning. Sellable as mastermind upgrade.
One-time recording. Automated sales funnels. Lower per-student revenue but compounds.

options.pickIf: You want passive base + recurring community revenue.

decisionTrees.question: Build audience first or launch first?

options.pickIf: You don't have an existing audience or email list.
options.nextStep: 6+ months of content. Build to 1K email subscribers minimum. Then pre-sale.

options.pickIf: You have an existing audience (newsletter, YouTube, podcast).
options.nextStep: Pre-sale to your list. Build content based on what they buy. Faster path to revenue.

phases.name: Foundation
phases.description: Validate your topic, build the curriculum, and set up your platform

tasks.title: Identify and validate your course topic
tasks.description: List 5 areas where you have deep expertise from your job. For each, research demand: search volume, existing courses, Reddit/Quora questions asked. Pick the topic with highest demand and lowest quality competition.
tasks.deliverable: Course topic selected with validation data

tasks.title: Build the course outline with AI
tasks.description: Use Claude/ChatGPT to draft a detailed course outline: 6-10 modules, 3-5 lessons per module, learning objectives for each lesson, and homework assignments. Review and refine with your expertise — AI gives structure, you give substance.
tasks.deliverable: Complete course outline with modules and lessons

tasks.title: Script first 3 lessons with AI
tasks.description: Use AI to draft lesson scripts based on your outline. Feed it your talking points and style guide. Edit each script to add personal stories, real examples from your work, and your unique perspective.

tasks.title: Set up course platform and sales page
tasks.description: Create your course on Teachable, Gumroad, or your own site. Write the sales page copy (use AI to draft), add your bio, and set up payment processing. Set up early-bird pricing.
tasks.deliverable: Course platform live with sales page

phases.name: Launch
phases.description: Record, publish, and sell your first course

tasks.title: Record all course videos
tasks.description: Batch-record all lessons over 2-3 sessions. Use Loom for screen recordings and talking-head videos. Do not aim for perfection — aim for valuable content. You can re-record later.
tasks.deliverable: All course videos recorded and uploaded

tasks.title: Create supporting materials with AI
tasks.description: Use AI to generate workbooks, templates, cheat sheets, and quiz questions for each module. Design them in Canva. These add perceived value and justify premium pricing.

tasks.title: Host a free webinar to build launch list
tasks.description: Teach the first module for free on a live Zoom webinar. Collect emails of attendees. At the end, pitch the full course with early-bird pricing. This validates demand and creates urgency.

tasks.title: Launch to your email list and network
tasks.description: Send a 3-email launch sequence to webinar attendees and your personal network. Share on LinkedIn and Twitter/X.

phases.name: Scale
phases.description: Build evergreen marketing and expand your course catalog

tasks.title: Build YouTube content funnel
tasks.description: Create 8-12 YouTube videos that teach individual concepts from your course. Each video ends with a CTA to the full course. This is your evergreen lead generation engine.

tasks.title: Collect and promote student testimonials
tasks.description: Ask your first 20 students for video testimonials. Offer a free bonus module in exchange. Add testimonials to your sales page, YouTube videos, and social posts.

tasks.title: Launch affiliate program
tasks.description: Recruit students, bloggers in your niche, and YouTubers to promote your course.

tasks.title: Plan second course or premium tier
tasks.description: Based on student feedback and questions, identify the logical "next course" or advanced tier. Use the same AI workflow to outline and produce it faster than the first one.
